text:
taylor-peopleops: Heads-up: smaller handbook update — were introducing optional "Compliance Electives" (15-25m micro-trainings) for hybrid teams. :wave: Managers are asked to enroll direct reports by Apr 15. Tracking & ack process below.

maria-peopleops: link to the tracker: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/abc123 (read-only until managers RSVP) :spiral_notepad:

samir-eng: quick q — are these required or opt-in per person?

taylor-peopleops: Opt-in for individual contributors. Managers should complete enrollments for their team (so we can surface completions in performance-ready reports). :white_check_mark:

anika-hr: For compliance reasons we still need an audit trail. Were adding an automated acknowledgment flow — once a person completes a micro-training the LMS will record the ack and the tracker gets updated.

jordan-manager: If I enroll my team can I export a CSV with completion status for my 1:1s?

maria-peopleops: Yep — manager export will be available in People Console > Learning > Exports. CSV columns:
```
employee_id, employee_email, manager_email, elective_name, enrolled_at, completed_at, ack_url
```

samir-eng: How do we handle contractors & exemptions?

taylor-peopleops: Contractors are excluded by default. If a contractor should be enrolled tag @taylor-peopleops with the contractor email and reason; we'll handle exceptions.

anika-hr: Reminder: security refresh (required) is still separate — this elective track doesn't replace required modules.

lms-bot: Reminder scheduled: Enrollment deadline in 30 days (Apr 15 09:00 PDT).

jordan-manager: Can we bulk enroll via CSV upload? We have ~40 ICs across projects.

maria-peopleops: Yes — manager bulk enroll (CSV template in the tracker). Use the same columns as exports, fill enrolled_at and elective_name. We'll validate on upload. :+1:

samir-eng: Great. Any SLA for responses if there are issues with enrollments?

taylor-peopleops: Please open a ticket in #help and add the tracker row id. Well aim to respond within 48 hours.

anika-hr: Ops note: exemptions & accommodations are logged to the same tracker tab (HR only view). Managers, please don't put sensitive accommodation details directly in comments — use HR ticketing.

maria-peopleops: Timeline recap: announcement today; manager RSVP + bulk enroll by Apr 1; final enrollments by Apr 15; automated reminders run Apr 16-30; performance reports include completions in May cycle.

jordan-manager: Thanks — I'll start the CSV prep this afternoon. :thumbsup:

taylor-peopleops: Thanks all. If anyone wants a quick 10m walkthrough of the tracker/flow ping me and Ill set up a screen share. :calendar:
